notes: Horchow.com is fully retired and redirects to neimanmarcus.com; Horchow's catalogue is now the NM Home department (confirmed in prior Furniture-pass notes and re-confirmed on this pass). ACCESS: curl_cffi impersonate=safari17_0 direct fetch reached the site fine for the first ~15 requests (homepage, sitemap, category pages); a later probe against an internal JSON API endpoint (/dt/api/search) got a DataDome 403, and a subsequent normal /c/ page fetch also returned 403 - so this host is now considered blocked for the remainder of the session per protocol (no retries/backoff attempted). All data below was gathered BEFORE the block. NAVIGATION DISCOVERY: (1) Top-level site nav (SSR homepage HTML) lists exactly 13 silos: New Arrivals, The Edits, Designers, Clothing, Shoes, Handbags, Jewelry, Accessories, Beauty, Kids, Home, Gifts, Sale - no 'Best Sellers' top-level nav item. (2) Downloaded and grepped the full category sitemap (neimanmarcus.com/sitemap_category_1.xml.gz, ~9000+ <sit:loc> URLs) for best-seller/bestseller/top-seller/most-wanted/customer-favorite/trending patterns: found dedicated Best Sellers PLPs for Clothing (best-sellers-clothing-cat1729009182), Shoes (best-sellers-shoes-cat1729011046), Jewelry & Accessories (best-sellers-jewelry--accessories-cat1729011308), Handbags/Beauty/Men's (new-now-best-sellers-* family, e.g. cat85610751 which I opened and confirmed via its breadcrumb schema.org JSON-LD is 'All Men > Best Sellers', i.e. Men's Best Sellers) and Cologne/Grooming (cologne-grooming-discover-best-sellers-cat87960735). NONE of these dozens of best-seller URLs are under the Home silo (cat000553) or its New Arrivals/Sale branches - every Home-branch sub-URL in the sitemap was inspected by keyword and none contains best-seller/bestseller/top-seller/popular/trending/customer-favorite. (3) The Home mega-menu promo tiles (rendered server-side) only surface Christmas Decor, Gourmet Food & Treats, Ornaments & Tree Decor, Home Gifts, Dining & Entertaining, Home Decor, Furniture, Kitchen - no Best Sellers tile. (4) Site search (/s/?q=...) returned HTTP 200 but is client-rendered (results build via JS after load), so raw HTML gave no reliable result count; this is supporting evidence only per the brief and does not override the exhaustive sitemap/nav check. CONCLUSION: Neiman Marcus (Horchow's current storefront) exposes a genuine Best Sellers merchandising concept, but only for Clothing/Shoes/Handbags/Jewelry/Accessories/Beauty/Men's - it has deliberately NOT built a Home-department Best Sellers PLP. No genuine Bestsellers PLP exists for the Home/Horchow product line.
